title: Homewood Sales
description: Homewood Sales Corporation specializes in equipment life extension solutions, offering a wide range of products including automatic voltage regulators, control panels, and motors, all built to Westinghouse specifications. With over a century of expertise, they provide exceptional quality in industrial and power distribution units and components. Their services include global sourcing, factory revitalization, and technical support, ensuring precise and expert assistance for their clients. Homewood primarily serves industries requiring reliable power distribution and equipment maintenance solutions.
